[A] a large majority of Canadians agree that the treatment of Aboriginal children under the residential schools policy amounted to a cultural genocide,

Cultural genocide doesn't make sense to me. Maybe a "culturicide" or simply cultural assimilation. Genocide means trying to wipe out a population, preventing it from reproducing. I don't think that's what happened, at least not with the residential schools.

The TRC defined cultural genocide as

"the destruction of those structures and practices that allow the group to continue as a group." That includes disrupting families "to prevent the transmission of cultural values and identity from one generation to the next."

The Canadian government attempted to wipe out a culture, as Stephen Harper noted in the federal apology "to kill the Indian in the child".

Given the cold and calculating way that the program was run, tactics that were used, and its ultimate goal, I have no difficulty with the phrase.
